models_evaluated: SingHealth Note Buddy (in-house ambient AI scribe: automatic speech recognition + generative LLM)

links.outcome: WHO-aligned report completeness with workflow including visible missing-information cues
links.effect: Completeness 13.61 vs 11.81; cluster-adjusted difference 1.95 (95% CI 0.91-3.00; P<.001); persisted after deformatting (1.70, 95% CI 0.27-3.14). Bundled workflow, voluntary adopters; cue effect not isolated.
links.quote: Unadjusted mean WHO total completeness was 11.81 (SD 3.39) for conventional reports and 13.61 (SD 2.54) for NARRATE reports; the unadjusted difference was 1.80 points, and the cluster-adjusted mean difference was 1.95 (95% CI 0.91-3.00; P<.001).

links.quote: Unadjusted mean WHO total completeness was 11.81 (SD 3.39) for conventional reports and 13.61 (SD 2.54) for NARRATE reports; the unadjusted difference was 1.80 points, and the cluster-adjusted mean difference was 1.95 (95% CI 0.91-3.00; P<.001).

links.effect: The cluster-adjusted mean difference for the adapted PDQI mean score was 0.53 points higher for AI-supported reports (95% CI 0.37-0.69; P<.001).
links.quote: After accounting for multiple reports contributed by the same supervisor, the cluster-adjusted mean difference was 0.53 (95% CI 0.37‐0.69; P <.001) points.
